scope: Original authored six-line text screen, three generations and one blinded semantic review. Research only.
authentication: Existing signed-in ChatGPT through production isolated Codex CLI; no API key

recommendation.next_trial: gpt-6-astra at medium effort for a bounded local-audio comparison
recommendation.basis: Both stronger models preserved explicit time bound and negative-confirmation phrasing. Astra had fewer requested invalid Latin maps and lower observed single-call latency than Sol in this run.
recommendation.production_adoption: Not justified by this small text-only screen. No production model change performed.
recommendation.review_candidate: gpt-6-astra high, assessed here only as one meaning judge; not independently calibrated accuracy.

independent_text_inspection.reviewer: Separate app_review agent; no additional model calls; not a native human listener

items.finding: ఆరు గంటలకి రావొచ్చు suggests possible arrival at six; Sol/Astra ఆరింటికల్లా explicitly preserves by-six latest bound. Temporal scope loss or ambiguity, not loss of uncertainty.
Direct ఇంకా డబ్బులు కట్టలేదా? preserves a negative question but less clearly the source negative-confirmation expectation; Sol/Astra retain కదా.
రెండొందల is colloquial two hundred; number-heuristic missing-hundred flag is a false positive on this authored example.
Other core names, quantities, negation, uncertainty, idiom paraphrase, message recipient and after-meeting ordering retained in model text inspection.
Inspected Latin proposals do not replace unrelated words. Attached Telugu endings remain in Telugu after local map validation.

latin_plan.meaning: Counts measure map compatibility only, not how the TTS pronounces each form.

limits: n=1 generation per configuration, fixed order Luna/Sol/Astra, uncontrolled provider cache and server load.
Generation used identical current production prompt/schema/brief with full-only wording, not the whole rendering pipeline or a shortened tier test.
One independent Astra-high request saw shuffled opaque IDs and both Telugu and planned Latin forms, without source-model labels; same-model self-preference/correlated errors remain possible.

Production REVIEW_SYSTEM explicitly evaluates meaning only, not style or pronunciation. Text inspection does not establish native acceptability, voice naturalness, TTS intelligibility or clone similarity.
The six original lines are deliberately diagnostic, not representative Telugu accuracy. No automatic adoption, corrective calls or actual audio.
